sF.text:
F · Your brief

Small compass from A1 (40 px keys), the eye is look, Flee left of S. The map (Shimrod, about 6 to 7 rooms each way, locked zoom) is drawn in the top third and fades in as the text fades out.

Fight card on top only while fighting: HP against HP, or the tank's name against the enemy.

Chat icon top right. A private message drops in as a slim card; tap it or the icon and Comm unfolds over the map area. The compose field just says Type a message.

Other panes: a strip pulled down from the top, one pane at a time, tabs to switch.

sG.text:
G · One shelf (challenge)

In F the top edge has three things that come down: the tell card, Comm, and the pane strip. Here they are one shelf with one handle. Comm is simply the first tab; the chat icon jumps to it.

The shelf has two heights: low (about 22 %) for Timers, Group, Character, Statistics, tall (about 40 %) for Comm. Drag for anything between.

The fight card is the shelf's closed state.

sH.text:
H · The map (challenge)

H1/H2 Breathing: the map is strong when nothing happens and steps back by itself when text pours in (a fight), so it never competes with what you read.

H3 Lens: instead of a full-width fade, a round window on the map around your room, in the top right corner. Text keeps full strength everywhere else.

H4 Peek: hold the eye key and the whole map comes forward for as long as you hold.

sI.text:
I · Thumb reach (challenge)

You noted that the old Flee could not be reached by the thumb. A chat icon in the top right corner and a pull from the top edge have the same problem on a tall phone.

Here the things you look at stay at the top, but everything you touch is at the bottom: a small left-hand cluster (Chat, Panes) mirrors the compass. A tell shows just above the input. The strip changes pane by a sideways swipe or by tapping Panes again.
